claims.text: House Ailil prides itself on power, diplomacy and intrigue and wears its Unseelie nature openly; its emblem is the dragon.
The house holds that it led the Winter Court of old, a place it says House Gwydion has usurped since the Resurgence.

title: Ailil and the right of demesne
summary: Why House Ailil contests Seelie holdings.

claims.text: When the noble houses returned in 1969, Seelie houses seized every freehold they could and drove out the commoners who had kept them; Ailil says many of those freeholds were once its own and refuses to honor the new holders.
Yet Ailil gives full respect to a Seelie noble who restores a freehold that belonged to that noble's house before the Sundering.

title: Leanhaun and Liam
summary: An old grudge between two houses.

claims.text: Leanhaun tradition blames Finellia's jealousy and a hasty curse for driving the house into the Unseelie camp, and calls Finellia, not the whole of House Liam, the true oath breaker; stories of Liam's disgrace all trace to some misstep by King Liam.
House Liam scorns Leanhaun for preying on mortals.
